name: Basil
description: Basil is an aromatic culinary herb with tender, fragrant leaves.
usefulInformation: Popular in pesto, salads and Mediterranean cooking.
healthBenefits: Contains aromatic compounds and plant polyphenols; evidence for specific clinical benefits remains limited.
medicinalUses: Traditionally used in herbal preparations for digestion; not a substitute for medical treatment.

additionalInformation.growingTips: Grow in well-drained soil and adjust watering and sunlight to local conditions.
additionalInformation.harvesting: Harvest gently, leaving enough growth for the plant to recover.
additionalInformation.gardenNote: A useful addition to a kitchen and pollinator-friendly herb garden.
